DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みの金額についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa halaga ng transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一回の上限より多いので、二回に分ければ今日全部送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一回上限を二回分割で超えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Lampas sa per-transfer limit; maaari bang dalawa para maipadala lahat ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung malalampasan ang per-transfer limit sa dalawang bahagi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一回と一日の条件は別に確認が必要です。まだ操作は始めていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang per-transfer at per-day conditions. Hindi pa nagsisimula?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始めていません。一回を小さくすれば一日の合計には制限がないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未操作で一日合計の条件を未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po. Akala ko walang daily total limit kung maliit bawat transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang operasyon at hindi pa tiyak ang daily total. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用方法の条件を担当へ確認します。相手は分割の入金を了承していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itatanong ang use conditions. Pumayag ang tatanggap sa split deposits?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞いていません。二回に分けるなら、相手の照合方法も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の分割了承も未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko pa po naitanong. Kung dalawa, gusto kong tiyakin pati pagtutugma niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa tiyak ang split consent ng tatanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同日の利用条件と、相手が求める支払いの形式を分けてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hiwalay pag-usapan ang daily conditions at payment format na kailangan ng tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。振込のメモに同じ請求番号を付けることだけで、相手が二回分を正しく扱うとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 請求番号だけで相手の照合成功を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko ipagpapalagay na matutugma niya ang dalawa dahil parehong invoice number sa memo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag asahan ang pagtutugma dahil invoice number lang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず条件をご案内します。今すぐ一回目だけを実行することはご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag muna ang kondisyon. Gusto bang unang transfer muna ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: しません。銀行の条件と相手の了承がそろってから、方法と回数を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両側の条件確認まで一回目も実行しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi po. Paraan at bilang pagkatapos ng bank conditions at recipient consent.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag simulan kahit una hanggang tiyak ang dalawang panig. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご相談として担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SETAGAYA-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Igagabay sa staff bilang ganoong konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送の料金は、差出人払いをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sender-paid po ba ang shipping fee?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買ってくれる人へ送るので、着払いにします。それで商品代も受取人から集めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 着払いで送料と商品代を両方回収できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa bibili ko po ipapadala kaya recipient-paid. Makokolekta rin ba ang product price?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung pareho ang shipping at product-price collection sa recipient-paid. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面での着払いは送料の支払いです。商品代の回収とは別に相談が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shipping fee ang recipient-paid dito. Hiwalay ang product-price collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送料と代金を一緒に回収すると思っていました。商品代はまだ受け取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品代は未受領で送料と混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po pareho. Hindi ko pa natatanggap ang bayad ng produkto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing unpaid ang produkto at nahalo sa shipping. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品代の支払い方法は相手と確認してください。送料の負担は相手と決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin sa buyer ang product payment. Napagkasunduan ang shipping payer?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 決まっていません。商品を買うと言っただけで、着払い送料まで了承したとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入同意と着払送料の了承を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa po. Pagbili lang ang sinabi, hindi pa pahintulot sa recipient-paid shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang purchase agreement at recipient-paid shipping consent. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。発送条件を先に確認しましょう。今日はまだ受付を進めないご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo. Tiyakin muna ang shipping conditions. Hindi muna ipoproseso ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ってください。商品代の方法と送料負担を相手へ確認してから、発送を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付を保留して両支払条件を相手へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maghintay po. Bayad ng produkto at shipping muna sa buyer bago magpasya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban at tiyakin sa buyer ang parehong bayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その後、対応できる発送方法と料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos, ituturo ang puwedeng shipping at presyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。着払いという言葉だけで両方決済できると伝えず、二つを分けて合意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品代と送料を別々に合意してから発送相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi ko sasabihing pareho ang nalulutas ng recipient-paid; magkahiwalay kaming sasang-ayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magkasundo nang hiwalay sa produkto at shipping bago konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、発送条件をご相談ください。今は荷物をお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SHIBUYA-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Pagkatapos matiyak, magtanong sa shipping. Ibabalik muna ang parcel.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕上がったコートはこちらです。

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腰のベルトがありません。コートと一緒に預けたと思うので、確認できますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベルトが見当たらず預けた記録の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala po ang belt. Naalala kong kasama nang iniwan; maaari bang tingnan?
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng record check dahil walang belt. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かり時の付属品記録を確認します。ベルトを外して渡したか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titingnan ang accessory record. Naalala kung inalis bago ibigay?

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付けたまま渡した記憶ですが、確かではありません。紛失したと決める前に控えを見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記憶は不確かと伝え紛失断定前に控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Parang nakakabit po pero hindi tiyak. Pakitingnan ang kopya bago sabihing nawala.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi tiyak ang alaala at ipakita ang kopya bago lost conclusion. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えには付属ベルト一点とあります。別に仕上げて保管されていないか担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Isang belt ang record. Itatanong kung hiwalay na nalinis at nakaimbak.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の記憶だけでなく記録にもあるのですね。このコートの受付番号で探してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号で付属品の所在確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po pala alaala lang, may tala. Pakihanap sa reception number ng coat.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng accessory location gamit ang reception number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号で確認します。隣にある似た色のベルトは、別のお客様の物です。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Numero ang titingnan. Sa ibang customer ang kahawig na belt sa tabi.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それを代わりに受け取ることはしません。自分の番号の確認が済むまで、コートもここで見せたまま待ちます。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人の類似品を代用せず照合を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po tatanggapin bilang kapalit. Ipapakita ang coat at maghihintay ng sariling numero.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ipalit ang kahawig na iba at hintayin ang pagtutugma. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が該当番号の付属品を持ってきました。こちらが記録のベルトです。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dinala na ng staff ang kaukulang accessory. Ito ang nasa record.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コートに合わせて確認します。付属品もそろったことを確かめてから、一緒に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コートとベルトの組を確認して受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itutugma ko po sa coat. Kapag kumpleto ang accessory, sabay iuuwi.
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang coat at belt pair bago tanggapin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではコートとベルトを一緒にお渡しします。受付の控えもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-SUGINAMI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sabay ibibigay ang coat at belt. Tingnan rin ang receipt copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文前に確認したいことはありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そばを避ける必要があります。写真のそばの実だけ抜けば、この麺料理を頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: そば回避のためトッピング除去だけで頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kailangan ko pong umiwas sa soba. Kung alisin lang ang buckwheat grains sa photo, maaari bang noodles na ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung topping removal lamang para sa soba avoidance. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: トッピングだけでなく、麺や調理条件も確認する必要があります。まだ注文は通しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangan pati noodles at cooking conditions, hindi topping lang. Hindi pa ipapasa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の粒だけを見ていました。麺そのものの材料も含めて、担当に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 麺材料を見落としたと認め担当の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Photo grains lang po ang nakita ko. Pakipaliwanag ng staff pati noodles ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Amining hindi napansin ang noodles ingredients at humiling ng paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理担当を呼びます。別の麺へ替えるご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tatawagin ang tagaluto. Gusto rin bang ibang noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 替えれば大丈夫と自分で決めません。別の麺でも、調理場所や器具について確認してから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別麺も適合を決めず調理条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping sapat ang pagpapalit. Kahit iba, kitchen at equipment muna bago mag-isip.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ipalagay na angkop ang iba at tiyakin ang pagluluto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件も伝えます。対応ができるとここでは保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapasa rin iyon. Hindi magagarantiya dito ang tugon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では候補を先に確定せず、避ける必要がある内容を担当へ伝えます。同行者にもまだ私の分を注文しないよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文を保留し同行者の代理注文も止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po pipiliin agad; sasabihin ang dapat iwasan. Pakiusapan din ang kasama na huwag umorder para sa akin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban at ihinto pati proxy order ng kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明を聞いた後で、注文するかを決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos ng paliwanag, makapagpapasya kung oorder.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。トッピング変更だけでは済ませず、材料と調理の説明を聞いてから自分の注文を判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と調理説明後に自分の注文を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi topping change lang; sangkap at luto muna bago sariling order decision.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya sa sariling order matapos ang sangkap at cooking explanation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が来るまでお待ちください。今のご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Hintayin ang staff. Ipapasa ang gusto ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目の症状と、今気になっていることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pakisabi ang sintomas sa mata at inaalala ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左目に違和感があります。コンタクトが外れたと思うのですが、どこへ行ったか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左目の違和感とコンタクトが外れたと思うが所在不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May kakaiba po sa kaliwa. Akala ko natanggal ang contact pero hindi ko alam kung nasaan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kaliwang discomfort at hinihinalang natanggal ngunit hindi makita ang contact. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外れたことを実際に確認したのですか。それとも見え方からそう思いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Natiyak bang natanggal o sa paningin lamang nahulaan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見えにくくなったので、そう思いました。外れたレンズは見つけておらず、目に残っているかも自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見え方による推測で外れた現物と現在装着を確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Lumabo po kaya inakala ko. Wala akong nakitang lens at hindi ko alam kung nasa mata pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hula sa paningin at hindi natiyak ang natanggal na lens o kasalukuyang suot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 装着中か不明という状態を診療担当へ伝えます。予備のレンズをもう着けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipapasa na hindi alam kung suot pa. Nagsuot na ng spare?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。予備は未開封で持っています。外れたはずと決めて重ねて着けず、先に担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予備未開封を示し追加装着前に担当の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa po. Selyado ang spare. Hindi ko ipapatong sa pag-aakalang natanggal; gabay muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang selyadong spare at humiling ng gabay bago dagdag na suot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。最後に装着したことを確認できた時点と、その後の経過を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige po. Kailan huling tiyak na suot at ano ang sumunod?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝七時に着けました。昼に見えにくくなりましたが、外した記憶はありません。装着時点と気付いた時点を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 朝七時装着と昼の変化を分け外した記憶がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Alas-siyete po ngayong umaga. Lumabo tanghali pero walang alaalang tinanggal. Hiwalay ang suot at oras na napansin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang alas-siyete na suot at tanghaling pagbabago at walang alaalang pag-alis. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過を記録します。違和感のほかに、受付で伝えておきたい症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatala iyon. May iba pang sintomas na sasabihin sa reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左目に赤みもあります。レンズが残っているからだとは断定せず、赤みと見え方、装着が未確認であることを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 赤みを追加し原因を断定せず症状と未確認の装着状態を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: May pamumula rin po sa kaliwa. Hindi ko ituturing na dahil may lens; pamumula, paningin at hindi tiyak na suot ang ipapaliwanag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Idagdag ang pamumula nang hindi tinitiyak ang sanhi at ipasa ang sintomas at unknown lens status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 左目の違和感と赤み、今朝の装着、昼の見え方の変化、現在の装着状態は不明と記録しました。予備は未使用のままお持ちください。診療担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naitala ang kaliwang discomfort at pamumula, umagang pagsuot, tanghaling pagbabago at hindi alam ang ngayon. Panatilihing hindi gamit ang spare. Ipapasa sa medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの席で準備できます。困るところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari nang maghanda sa upuang ito. May problema?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左利きです。右手へ持ち替えないと、この体験には参加できませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きで参加する条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kaliwete po. Kailangan bang lumipat sa kanan para makasali?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang conditions para sa kaliweteng pagsali. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使う手と準備の方法を先生に相談できます。今ここで無理に持ち替える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring isangguni sa guro ang kamay at paghahanda. Hindi kailangang piliting ilipat ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左手で参加したいです。隣の方の袖へ腕が当たりそうなので、席の間隔も見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左手希望と隣席の袖への接触懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaliwa po ang gusto ko. Baka dumikit ang braso sa manggas ng katabi, kaya pakitingnan ang agwat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kaliwang kamay at pangambang tumama sa manggas ng katabi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先生が配置を確認します。隣の方の道具は動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Guro ang titingin sa ayos. Huwag ilipat ang gamit ng katabi.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かしません。自分の墨も右側にあり、手を伸ばす時に袖が触れそうです。置場を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の道具を動かさず自分の墨の置場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po. Nasa kanan din ang tinta ko; baka dumikit ang manggas sa pag-abot. Gusto kong itanong ang puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ilipat ang ibang gamit at itanong ang sariling tinta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自分の道具の置場も一緒に確認しましょう。墨を入れる前に、筆を持つ動きを示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabay tingnan ang sariling gamit. Bago lagyan ng tinta, maipapakita ang paghawak ng brush?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。空の筆で動きを見せます。先に墨を入れてから、隣の道具を避けようとするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 墨を入れる前に空の筆で動きを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo, tuyong brush ang pangpakita. Hindi muna lalagyan saka iiwas sa gamit ng katabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita sa walang tintang brush bago lagyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配置が確認できました。先生の案内で、ご自身の道具をこの位置へ準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Natiyak ang ayos. Ayon sa guro, ihanda ang sariling gamit dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この位置で袖が触れないかもう一度確認します。自分の道具だけ準備し、左手で始める方法を先生に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袖と配置を再確認し自分の道具だけ準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titiyakin ko pong muli kung walang tama ang manggas. Sariling gamit lang at itatanong ang pagsisimula sa kaliwa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin muli ang manggas at ayos at ihanda lamang ang sariling gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では先生と準備しましょう。隣の方の道具はそのままで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghanda kasama ang guro. Iwan ang gamit ng katabi.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会議室をご希望ですか。どのような用途でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Meeting room po ba? Para saan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人と日本語を練習したいです。部屋を予約したら、参加者にも案内が届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋予約で参加者への案内が出るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Magpa-practice po ng Japanese sa kapitbahay. Kapag reserved ang room, matatanggap din ba nila ang invitation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung room booking ay may invitations sa participants. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋の予約だけで参加者への募集案内が出るわけではありません。主催者の方で準備する内容も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi awtomatikong recruitment notice ang room reservation. Tiyakin din ang organizer tasks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 施設が参加者を集める会だと思っていました。自分が主催する集まりとして、利用条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分が主催する会として利用条件を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po facility ang mangangalap. Sarili kong pagtitipon kaya pakisabi ang conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta sa use conditions bilang sariling organizer. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数の見込みと、活動内容を伺います。参加者はもう決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ilan ang inaasahan at ano ang gawain? Tiyak na ang participants?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ決まっていません。最大十人を考えていますが、十人の申込みがあるとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最大見込み人数と実際の申込未定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa po. Hanggang sampu ang plano pero hindi ko sasabihing may sampung nag-apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang maximum estimate at hindi pa tiyak na actual applications. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用条件を確認しましょう。施設内で募集案内を掲示したい場合は、別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang conditions. Hiwalay na approval para mag-post ng recruitment sa facility.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋が取れたら掲示も許可されたとは考えません。自分の募集案を作ってから、掲示の条件を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約と掲示許可を分け募集案で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping kasama ang poster permission sa booking. Gagawa ng draft saka itatanong ang posting conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang booking at posting at kumonsulta gamit ang draft. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部屋の申込み方法と掲示の相談先を分けてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay ituturo ang room application at poster contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。参加者募集は自分で準備し、部屋の受付と掲示の可否をそれぞれ確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 募集を自分で準備し二つの手続きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Ako ang recruitment; hiwalay titiyakin ang room at posting bago magpatuloy.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sariling recruitment at dalawang proseso ang tiyakin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの案内をお渡しします。今は予約確定ではなく、条件のご相談として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibibigay ang dalawa. Conditions consultation pa, hindi confirmed reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物のご注文について確認させてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の部屋の友人の飲み物も、私の端末で頼みました。店員さんが隣へ届けてくれると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣室の飲み物を自室端末で頼んだと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa terminal ko po inorder ang drinks ng kaibigan sa kabilang room. Akala ko doon ihahatid ng staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang pag-order ng katabing room gamit ang sariling terminal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この端末の注文は、この部屋の注文として届いています。どの飲み物が隣の方の分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakatala bilang order ng room na ito. Alin ang para sa katabi?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二杯です。こちらの部屋の三杯とは分けたいです。まだ届いていないので、担当に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自室三杯と隣室希望二杯を区別して確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong dalawa po, hiwalay sa tatlo rito. Hindi pa dumating; pakitingnan sa staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang sariling tatlo at katabing dalawa at humiling ng pagsuri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文状況と扱いを確認します。隣の部屋の方にも、同じ飲み物を注文済みか聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang status. Itanong din kung naorder na nila ang pareho.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に聞くと、隣でも二杯頼んでいました。重複していますが、取り消せると決めず状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣室でも注文済みと報告し取消可否を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naitanong po; may dalawa rin sa kabila. Duplicate pero hindi ko masasabing puwedeng kanselahin, status ang sasabihin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat ang duplicate sa kabila at huwag magpasya sa cancellation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの部屋の注文を担当が照合します。追加注文は少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff ang magtutugma ng dalawang room. Huwag muna dagdagan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。届いた物を勝手に部屋間で移して解決せず、どちらの注文をどう扱うか説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加注文と勝手な部屋間移動を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Maghihintay po. Hindi ko ililipat basta sa ibang room ang dumating; pakikinggan ang paghawak sa bawat order.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihinto ang dagdag at sariling room-to-room transfer. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明に来ます。支払いも部屋ごとに確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Darating ang staff. Kailangan ding bill bawat room.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の三杯と重複した二杯を区別し、注文の扱いと各部屋の会計を確認してから次を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み物の内訳と両部屋の会計を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ihihiwalay ang tatlo at duplicate dalawa at titiyakin ang orders at bills bago magdagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang breakdown at bill ng parehong rooms. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へその内容を伝えます。二つの部屋の番号で照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa iyan at itutugma ang dalawang room numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薄いですが、本の表紙があるので、持ち帰れば読めると思って選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表紙付きカードを読む本だと思って選んだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Manipis po pero may book cover kaya pinili kong mababasa pag-uwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing piniling librong mababasa ang cover card. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは電子版を利用するためのコード商品です。紙の本とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Code para sa e-book ito, hindi papel na libro.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中に印刷された本文がある商品ではないのですね。スマートフォンで使う条件を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電子版コードの意味を確認し利用条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala may printed text sa loob. Gusto kong tingnan ang phone use conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang electronic code at itanong ang use conditions. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用するサービスや端末の条件は、商品案内を確認してください。紙の本をご希望でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan sa product guide ang service at device conditions. Paper book ba ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母へ渡すつもりでした。母がそのサービスを使えるか分からないので、私の端末で使えればよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母への贈答で本人の利用環境が未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Para po sa nanay. Hindi ko alam kung magagamit niya ang service, kaya hindi sapat na gumana sa phone ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na para sa ina at hindi pa alam ang kanyang use setup. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 贈る方の利用条件が未確認なら、紙の本の在庫を確認することもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung hindi tiyak sa tatanggap, maaari rin tingnan ang paper stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ内容の紙版があるか調べてもらえますか。コードを開封して試すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同内容の紙版を探しコードを開封しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakihanap po ang parehong content sa papel. Hindi ko bubuksan ang code para subukan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hanapin ang parehong paper edition at huwag buksan ang code. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙版の版と内容を確認します。電子版と全く同じ構成かも説明を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titingnan ang paper edition at content. Tingnan din kung ganap na pareho ang composition sa e-book.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。母が使える形と内容を確認してから選びます。今のコード商品はまだ購入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人の利用形態と版の内容確認まで購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Paraang magagamit ni nanay at content muna bago pumili. Hindi muna bibilhin ang code.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban hanggang tiyak ang format at edition content para sa tatanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では紙版を確認します。コード商品は未開封のままお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titingnan ang paper edition. Kukunin ang code nang selyado.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の写真ではこの料理が品切れでした。今日は別の料理にしようと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の品切れ写真を理由に別料理を選ぶ予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Out of stock po ito sa photo kahapon, kaya iba na lang sana ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong iba dahil sa sold-out photo kahapon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は昨日の状態ですね。本日の提供状況を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kahapon ang photo. Matitiyak ang availability ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の品切れが続くと決めていました。今日もないのか、確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日の提供状況を確認してから選びたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po tuloy ang sold out. Gusto kong pumili matapos malaman kung wala pa rin ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng availability ngayon bago pumili. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日はこの料理を提供できると担当から案内されています。内容の説明も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabi ng staff available ngayon. Kailangan din ng paliwanag ng content?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。昨日の写真にある付け合わせと今日も同じか確認したいです。提供できることと内容が同じことは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提供可否と付け合わせの一致を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Pareho ba ang side dish sa photo kahapon? Magkaiba ang available at parehong nilalaman.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hiwalay tiyakin ang availability at side dish match. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日の付け合わせはこちらです。写真の野菜とは変わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ang side ngayon. Iba sa gulay sa photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 違いが分かりました。友人と分けるので、今日の付け合わせを伝えて希望を聞いてから注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の変更内容を同行者へ伝え希望を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Malinaw na po. Paghahatian namin kaya sasabihin ko ang side ngayon at tatanungin muna ang gusto niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaalam ang pagbabago ngayon sa kasama at itanong ang gusto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お返事が来るまで、注文はまだ通さずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hihintayin ang sagot at hindi muna ipapasa ang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人も今日の内容でよいそうです。この料理を一皿、今日の付け合わせでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者の了解後に今日の内容一皿を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ayos din po sa kaibigan ang ngayon. Isang plato nito na may side ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Umorder ng isang plato ngayon matapos pumayag ang kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の内容を確認した一皿としてお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-SUGINAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Isang natiyak na content ngayon ang tatanggapin.
